source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: A standard, readily sourced connector is fine; just make sure it is easy to obtain. If it is available on AliExpress, that is a sufficient check.

value_updates.connector_requirement: Replace the HRO TYPE-C-31-M-17 with a standard USB-C connector providing D+ and D- data lines.
value_updates.sourceability_requirement: The connector must be readily obtainable; availability on AliExpress is a sufficient sourcing check.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Availability is my only concern. This premium option normally costs 1.46$, while typical ones are 0.4$; we can use it provided compatible alternatives exist if it goes out of stock, since I do not want a part that may be unavailable regularly.

value_updates.sourceability_requirement: The proposed connector may be used only if compatible alternatives are available when it is out of stock.

routing_warnings.description: The successful USB workaround concerns the later integrated board's native USB path, not the power-board USB connector requirement.
